lean_statement:
∀ (ε : ℝ) (μ : DominantFiveBody.MassRatio),
  DominantFiveBody.masses ε μ 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ (i : DominantFiveBody.Satellite), DominantFiveBody.masses ε μ (Fin.succ i) = ε * μ i) ∧
      (DominantFiveBody.PositiveRatio μ ↔ (∀ (i : DominantFiveBody.Satellite), 0 < μ i) ∧ ∑ i, μ i = 1)

∀ (θ : DominantFiveBody.Satellite → ℝ),
  DominantFiveBody.CoorbitalAngleDomain θ ↔ θ 0 = 0 ∧ 0 < θ 1 ∧ θ 1 < θ 2 ∧ θ 2 < θ 3 ∧ θ 3 < Real.pi
